title: DSL And Op Text Pilot: Draw And Note
description: Wave 1 of the library/dsl/op/ui split refactor (plan: /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/all-technologies-should-be-groovy-wozniak.md). Implement DocumentDsl + OpText (from the vcs crate's new 🔖Text/🔖TextFormat regions, landed in ticket TEXTUAL-DSL-OP-LOG-AND-STATEFUL-VCS-MECHANISM) for the two pilot technologies: draw and note. Each gets a handcrafted textual document format and single-line op syntax, replacing its JSON example fixture, with round-trip tests. This establishes the pattern the remaining ~30 technologies will follow in later waves.
